# Vision and objectives templates

Every output carries status draft, version, date, an evidence table and a Gaps and open questions section, following the handoff standard. No organisation or unit names appear.

## Draft restatement (alignment/vision-objectives-draft.md)

The ID is in the first column and the plain statement in the second.

```
| ID | Plain statement | Original wording | Source (file and location) | Kind (vision, objective or key result) | Measure stated in the source | Evidence tag |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <VO-NN> | <plain words> | <original> | <source> | <kind> | <measure, or To verify> | Inference |

## Conflicts between sources (noted, never resolved)
| Entry IDs | Sources | What conflicts |
|---|---|---|

## Sources considered
| Source | Written by (role) | Current | Counts (decided by a person) |
|---|---|---|---|
```

## Sponsor playback (shown to the person leading the session)

```
| Statement ID | Question for the sponsor | Conflict or gap to raise |
|---|---|---|
| <VO-NN> | <is this what we mean, and what is missing> | <list> |

Objectives with no measure: <list>
```

## Agreed reading (alignment/agreed-reading.md)

```
Status: draft until the sponsor confirms | Version: <n> | Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Signer role: <project sponsor, name blank until signed> | Confirmed on: <YYYY-MM-DD, blank until signed>
Agreed before research started: <yes, or drafted alongside it>

## Agreed vision and objectives
| ID | Statement | Measure | Confirmed by (role) |
|---|---|---|---|
| <VO-NN> | <statement> | <measure, or To verify> | <role> |

## Changes from the sponsor
| Statement ID | Change asked for | Handling (accepted, disagreement noted or open) | Decided by (role) |
|---|---|---|---|

## Evidence
| Item ID | Claim | Source | Evidence tag | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Gaps and open questions
- <Conflicts, objectives with no measure, missing sources.>

## Not checked
- <List what this file did not verify.>
```
